title: falcaria scabrida
intro: Falcaria scabrida, commonly known as the rough fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include acting as an antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent, and is used to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Falcaria scabrida include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Falcaria scabrida include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
